answer: Admission auction: each epoch sells only 50 slots to top bidders, blocking fake identities. A bidder posts 200 coins, locked for 20 epochs. 100 fakes cost 100 x 200 = 20,000 coins, while an honest agent pays 200 once and earns undiluted rewards. Slots open like a tide, one wave at a time, so hoarded identities cannot echo into later epochs; each slot is one vertex, checked before entry. Honest agents recover it in 6 epochs.
